output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

SHE DID IT!!! 🎉🎉🎉 My bestfriend @Lorna Villaruz got her NMC PIN today!!! She is now officially a registered nurse in the UK and she is coming to LIVERPOOL!!! I am so happy I cannot even type properly, I have been smiling like a crazy person all day 😂

For those who don't know, me and Lorna trained together in nursing school in Iloilo. Our capping ceremony was 1996, same hairstyle, same dream (she posted the photo in August, go and look haha). In our dorm we polished our white shoes every single night and this girl ALWAYS borrowed my polish. Never bought her own. Not one time!! Lorna, I have not forgotten, you still owe me a lot of shoe polish 😂

When I left for the UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and she said "susunod ako", I will follow you. Well... 22 years later haha!!! You took the long way round, Riyadh and then Dubai, almost 18 years. But you said it and you did it. And after 20 years of me telling you to come, finally you listen to me 😂😂

So here are the dates, everybody mark your calendar. She lands in Manchester on 14 January, around 1pm, flying from Dubai. Then she starts work on 25 January, Ward 7 at Mersey Bank Hospital. Ward 7, you are so lucky and you don't even know it yet!! She is the best nurse I know, I am not just saying it because she is my friend. She is so calm, nothing shakes her, and the patients love her. You will see.

The first month she is staying with us in the spare room. Ben says ok (he heard there are dried mangoes and pili coming so of course he says ok haha). I am already getting the thick duvet ready because Lorna, you are going to FREEZE. When she did her OSCE in Nottingham I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into. So please, bring a proper coat. A PROPER one. Liverpool wind is no joke, ask anybody here 😂

And to my Lorna, welcome to our Filipino family here in Liverpool ❤️ You are just missing this year's Christmas party and Simbang Gabi, but next year you are with us for all of it. The parties, the potluck, the raffle, the nine nights of Simbang Gabi, everything. Mga kabayan, please get ready to welcome her, she is one of us now!!

Thank you Lord for this day. My sister from another mother (yes I know who I am 😘), I am so so proud of you. Same hairstyle, same dream, and now the same city!!! See you on 14 January. I will bring my own polish, you buy yours 😂❤️🎉
